sections.heading: Six ways we work with institutions

items.title: Campus Workshops
items.text: Hands-on sessions on AI, robotics, cyber security and emerging tools, run on your campus and sized to a single department or a whole year group.

items.title: Industrial Training
items.text: 45-day, 6-week and 6-month programmes mapped to university training requirements, so a session completes its mandated hours without a timetable clash.

items.title: Placement Drives
items.text: Joint drives and pre-placement talks with the employers who recruit from us, hosted on your campus or at our Lucknow centre.

items.title: Faculty Development
items.text: Short programmes that bring teaching staff up to date on the stacks their students will be interviewed on: cloud, data and modern web tooling.

items.title: Curriculum Alignment
items.text: Advisory sessions with heads of department to shape practical syllabi around what local and national employers are actually hiring for.

items.title: Hackathons & Contests
items.text: Co-branded coding, CAD and design competitions with problem statements from real industry projects and verified certificates for finalists.

sections.heading: From first call to a running programme

items.title: Initial Conversation
items.text: We understand your department's timeline, student count and academic requirements.

items.title: Customised Proposal
items.text: We share a detailed syllabus, trainer credentials, project deliverables and commercial terms.

items.title: MOU & Scheduling
items.text: Formal agreement signed, dates locked in, and labs or infrastructure prepared.

items.title: Execution & Outcomes
items.text: Hands-on delivery, project submissions, student assessments and joint certification.

sections.heading: Tell us what your students need next.
sections.text: Send us your department, student numbers and the semester you are planning for, and we will come back with a written proposal covering scope, duration, delivery mode and cost.

items.title: Industrial training
items.text: 45 days, 6 weeks, 6 months and 9 months, aligned to university requirements and closed with an internship letter.

items.title: Events & workshops
items.text: Seminars and hands-on sessions at our campus and at colleges across Uttar Pradesh — most of them free, all taught by our own trainers.

items.title: Visit or book a demo
items.text: The Kursi Road campus, session timings, fees and EMI options — or a free demo class before you commit to anything.

sections.heading: Would you rather we called you?
sections.text: Leave a number and a counsellor calls back within one working day — or reach us now on {{phone}} .

sections.heading: Start building your career today.
sections.text: Talk to a counsellor today. One call is usually enough to know which track fits your degree, your schedule and the job you want.
